Foreign Key Constraint Violation When Executing cp_recovery.sql – time_machine_pauses Record Referenced in time_machine_holes
Status Update:
Update:
Regression in the reconciliation.sql file because of the change in foreign key constraint in April.

The TM_hole and Tm_pause tables' foreign key was changed from ON DELETE NO ACTION to ON DELETE CASCADE.

To be able to propagate the changes done in parent table to the referenced tables, the reconciliation script first drops the constraint and recreate them with ON UPDATE cascade, and keeps the on DELETE as it is.
This activity was done before April and the queries were generated and maintained in the reconciliation file.

Since there was a change from ON DELETE NO Action to Cascade for a few tables. Those changes were not captured in the reconciliation.sql file and reconciliation failed during deletion of entries in one of the table.
